question: Under what conduct does a woman of good family become liable to abandonment?
premises: Traveling away is cited as a cause
Speaking inappropriately is cited as a cause
Such conduct renders a woman of good family worthy of abandonment
inference: A woman of good family becomes liable to abandonment due to traveling away or improper speaking.
uncertainties: The specific nature of the travel or speaking is not defined
plain_english: Because of traveling away or speaking improperly, a woman of good family may become worthy of abandonment.
